notes: Printed: 'Prowess. {R}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker.' Casting Short Sword (a noncreature spell) pumps the Immolator to 3/3 until end of turn. Sacrificing it then deals damage equal to its last-known power, 3, to the 5/5 Big Lug (damage mark 3, survives). Both red are spent (one for Short Sword, one for the activation).
